summary.note: lean_doc = family header in CONTENTS.md links a lean/docs/NNN.md scope document; this is family-level, not per-manuscript, and does not mean the whole family is formalized.
summary.about: Index of OpenAI's machine-written mathematics corpus (github.com/openai/math), compiled by Aska Research for the essay Math, faster. Family-level; lean_doc means the family links a Lean scope document, not that it is formalized.
summary.field_note: field = Foundation0's editorial classification of each family into one broad field, judged from its title (OpenAI's catalogue does not assign fields).
